text:
Priya Nair: Heads up — we started seeing a ~18% jump in renewal-risk flags this morning after the weekend automation tweak. Many look like false positives (trial accounts getting flagged).
Ben Cho: Yikes. Do you have a couple sample account IDs we can inspect?
Priya Nair: Yep, pulled 10 samples and ran a quick query. Main culprit seems to be the new "engagement_decay" signal combined with the support_ticket_count > 0 rule.
Priya Nair: SQL I used to pull the batch:
```sql
SELECT account_id, last_activity_at, support_ticket_count, engagement_decay_score
FROM cs_account_signals
WHERE flagged_for_renewal = true
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Olivia Park: Hmm. We increased the decay weight to 0.6 last week — that will amplify short gaps in usage into a risk. Maybe revert to 0.4 for accounts with lifecycle = "trial" or cohort < 30 days.
Samir Patel: +1. Also noticed support tickets get binary weight. We should cap it so a single low-priority ticket doesn't push an account into high risk. Suggest: ticket_weight = min(1, log(1 + priority_score)).
Ben Cho: Can we do a canary change? e.g., run the adjusted scoring for 5% of accounts and compare precision/recall for 72h.
Priya Nair: Yes. Plan I propose:
1) Temporarily reduce engagement_decay to 0.4 for cohorts < 30d
2) Change ticket weighting to the capped log formula for the canary group
3) Backfill scoring for the canary cohort (48h window) and monitor false positive rate vs control
4) Roll changes cluster-wide if FP rate drops >= 10% without hurting TP
Olivia Park: I'll create the canary list (stratified by ARR band).
Priya Nair: Putting estimated run steps into the automation runner. Job config snippet:
```json
{"job_name": "cs-signal-tune-canary-1981234567", "cohort": "canary_5pct", "changes": {"engagement_decay": 0.4, "ticket_weight": "log_cap"}}
```
CS Automation Bot: Scheduled job cs-signal-tune-canary-1981234567 for 2026-03-23 02:00 UTC. Estimated runtime 35m. Job ID: job_20260323_137.
Ben Cho: OK. Who needs to approve the canary? @Olivia Park @Samir Patel?
Olivia Park: Approved from segmentation side. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: Approved for weighting change. I'll watch alerting during the run. :eyes:
Priya Nair: Great — I'll post a short verification checklist in the incident channel after the backfill: precision, recall, and sample manual audit of 20 accounts.
Ben Cho: And please add a short note to the runbook about not applying the decay bump to cohorts < 30d. Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cs/signal-tuning
Priya Nair: Will do. Thanks all — will report back after job_20260323_137 completes.
